game_info.name: Apple Hop
game_info.description: Bouncey moves left and right to catch falling apples while avoiding stones!

objective.description: Catch apples to earn points. Avoid stones or lose health.
steps: Watch apples and stones fall from the top.
Move Bouncey left and right to catch apples.
If you touch a stone, you lose 1 health point.
Each caught apple adds 1 to your score.
Reach 15 points to win the level.
objective.lose_message: Bouncey ran out of health! Game Over!

mechanics: Apples and stones fall down from the top of the screen.
No more than the specified number of apples or stones can be on screen at once.
When Bouncey touches an apple, the score goes up by 1 and the apple disappears.
When Bouncey touches a stone, Bouncey loses 1 health and the stone disappears.
Bouncey's movement is limited to the screen area only.
The game ends in victory when score reaches 15, or in defeat when health reaches 0.

hud.description: Displays player's score and health visibly on the screen.

assets_required.description: Ggame background: panoramic twilight forest clearing under a violet-orange gradient sky.
Sprite image of the player character Bouncey.
Sprite image for the collectible apple.
A black stone, slightly irregular shape with rough edges, side-on view, simple shading to suggest texture.

sounds_required.description: Slow and soft background music for the game.
Quick sound effect played when the player successfully catches an apple.
Quick sound effect when the player hits the wall or boundary.
Victory sound effect played when the player wins the game.
Game over sound played when the player loses all health.
